client.business_model: Physician-led, multi-site dermatology practice network operating outpatient clinics across New England
client.client_history: Founded in 1992 as a solo dermatology practice, APDerm has expanded through acquisitions and de-novo clinic openings to become the largest physician-led dermatology network in New England, offering medical, surgical and cosmetic dermatology across Massachusetts, New Hampshire and Rhode Island.

revenue.notes: Growjo estimates 2024 revenue at ~$44.7M. LeadIQ lists $2.7M, which would imply <6k revenue per employee and is therefore likely erroneous. No official figures published; using Growjo but marking confidence low owing to large discrepancy and lack of primary disclosure.

locations.source: Indeed company 'About' page (https://www.indeed.com/cmp/Apderm/about) and BusinessWire press releases (Oct 12 2021 & other releases)
locations.notes: Indeed states the network operates 40 practices. BusinessWire release from Oct 2021 confirmed 32 offices; multiple new openings reported since then, supporting 40 as the most recent publicly stated figure.

employees.source: LeadIQ profile (501 employees) and Indeed company page (501–1,000 range)
employees.notes: Employee estimates vary widely: LeadIQ 501, SignalHire 249, Growjo 154, Clodura 105. LeadIQ aligns with Indeed’s range and is most consistent with a 40-location clinic network, so 500 is used but confidence kept medium due to discrepancies.
